Their pain and sorrow disappear as she melts them slowly and sensually, and when she's done absorbing a human, not even their bones will remain. Kanade and the other five ancestors helped their creator Alipheese, the Dark Goddess in the Great Monster Wars, a long bloody war instigated by the Goddess of Light, Ilias and after defeating Ilias and her legions of angels Alipheese rules over Makai.

entries.name: Fallen Seraph Micaela
entries.content:
Name: Micaela 

Appearance: Micaela is a tall seraph that has long blonde hair, blue eyes, six angel wings, and wears only a tattered ribbons that barely covers her busty body. She also has several insignias on her naked body that symbolize her light magic that she still wields.

Abilities: Besides her skill with her swordsmanship she's capable of high level holy and dark elemental magic, and she's able to force herself upon her opponent and drain them of their essence via sexual intercourse. She's also capable of telepathy, teleportation, and even flight thanks to her six black angel wings. Besides combat, Micaela is skilled in sexual pleasure making her victims orgasm while not feeling pleasure herself.

Personality: Ever since she discovered how awful Goddess Ilias was, she's now became cold, distant, and merciless, attacking angels, humans, and monster girl alike. Only her sister, Eden may be able to break Micaela out of her despair or die trying due to her immense strength.

History: Micaela is the first daughter and Seraph of Goddess Ilias and was dubbed the "Sword of Heaven". She faithfully served her along with her sisters Eden and Lucifina, and brought forth order to the world until Ilias declared war on monster girls and any human supporters that sided with Alipheese, the Dark Goddess. Despite having the advantage, the Holy Angel Army was quickly bulldozed by Alipheese's commitment to crush Ilias for instigating the war. Once the Army of the Dark Goddess breached heaven, Ilias was quickly exposed for her cowardly and manipulative behavior in starting this war, and was quickly executed by Alipheese herself, causing Eden and any survivors to flee with some of the angels while Micaela also ran away, Lucifina had fought valiantly but was overrun by the ancestors and perished to cover her comrades escape. With heaven lost, Ilias exposed as the instigator and a coward, along with Lucifina's sacrifice, Micaela succumbed to the darkness and despair, becoming a Dark Seraph, now hunting down all life and killing them outright if she sees them. She's now devoid of her original stoic, yet kind personality she was once known for. She's currently hiding in the Alice continent, deep within the Irina Mountain Range where she stalks unfortunate travelers.

entries.name: Seraph Eden
entries.content:
Name: Eden

Appearance: Eden has the appearance of a tall six winged angel woman with a completely nude body. She has grey blonde hair, blue eyes, and only wears her brown cloak.

Personality: Ever since the fall of heaven, Eden has maintained her stoic personality, despite the continous loss at the ancestors' hand. She's now more fearful if she'll even survive the next attack. 

Abilities: Eden is weaker than her sisters,  but she isn't a complete pushover, especially when fighting high level monsters, however her power has been lowered significantly due to her time on earth. 

History: Eden is the third daughter and Seraph of Goddess Ilias and was dubbed the "Great Seraph". She faithfully served her along with her sisters Eden and Lucifina, and brought forth order to the world until Ilias declared war on monster girls and any human supporters that sided with Alipheese, the Dark Goddess. Despite having the advantage, the Holy Angel Army was quickly bulldozed by Alipheese's commitment to crush Ilias for instigating the war. Once the Army of the Dark Goddess breached heaven, Ilias was quickly exposed for her cowardly and manipulative behavior in starting this war, and was quickly executed by Alipheese herself, causing Eden, Micaela, and any other angel survivors to flee, although Lucifina had fought valiantly but was overrun by the ancestors and perished in order to cover her comrades escape. With heaven lost, Ilias exposed as the instigator and a coward, along with Lucifina's sacrifice, she leads a group of rebels actively trying to resist Dark Goddess Alipheese's new reign over the world while also hiding from Hiruko, the tentacle monster girl ancestor, as she wants to consume the weakened seraph.

entries.name: Noah
entries.content: Noah is the northern most region of the Sentora continent it's grassy with a forest city known as Plansect Village. It is a haven for plant and insect monster girls, where most unfortunate humans are captured to become mates. Slimes are the dominant species in the Noah region since due to the efforts of Kanade to turn the water from Grand Noah into a habitable region for slimes. However, Grand Noah has a very harsh criminal code—even minor offenders will find themselves offered to Kanade as her next meal. As a result, there have been many incidences of humans being arrested and taken to Kanade to be eaten. Yamatai is also in the region which serves as a research city for magic and cybernetics under the governance of Tamamo no Mae of the six ancestors. This is where the research in cutting-edge technology is done; it's an open secret that they perform inhumane experiments on living subjects. It's said that those angels that survived the Great Holy War are also kept as test subjects in the most secret chambers of Yamatai. Besides Grand Noah some stronger slimes are born in Ghatanothoa's Spring which is the current location of Undine, the water elemental.

entries.name: Gold
entries.content: Gold is the northwestern region of the Sentora Region with a small desert patch to the east near the Noah region. The Gold region is governed by Kanon, the plant monster girl ancestor who has turned it's capital Grangold, into a multiracial hub for trading and is the symbol of coexistance between humans and monster girls. The region also has a port known as Gold Port, a trading port that trades with Hellgondo and Yamatai. There's also a volcano south of Gold Port called Gold Volcano. It is full of monster girls that assault human miners and passerbys in an attempt to find a suitable partner. Grimoire is located in the volcano as the spirit of fire.

entries.name: Natalia
entries.content: Natalia is the Southern most region of the Sentora continent is under the governance of Minagi, the succubus and vampire ancestor. It's capital, San Ilia was a holy and pristine city dedicated to worshiping Ilias, but is now a place where succubi thrive under It's eternal moonlit sky that never changes as human men and women are sent there to become sacrifices for the succubi's sick orgy rituals which form a lust barrier making human traveler's minds and unable to think straight, which makes them easy targets. West of San Ilia is the Spirit Forest which houses fairy monster girls and its guardian Ambrosia, the wind elemental. To the southwest of the capital is Port Natalia, a trading port with the Alice continent and a meeting place for mermaids to find suitable human husbands.

entries.name: Safina
entries.content: Safina is the southwestern region of the Sentora region. It is a desert region that is under the control of Alipheese's army under Hiruko, the scylla ancestor who has transformed the legendary desert kingdom of Sabasa into a tentacle haven with is buildings being dissolved by digestive mucus. There is a pyramid to the west of Sabasa where a mighty Sphinx lives with her guardians. It is the only location where the marriage of dragons is possible through the "Dragon Trial where humans prove their worth to their future partners. South of Sabasa near the desert is a village named "Witch Hunt Village" which is the only active rebel group fighting against Alipheese's rule, but it seems as if they're doomed to fail. There's a mysterious ruins in the desert that supposedly houses Loa, the earth elemental.

entries.name: Humans
entries.content: Humans, creations of the Goddess Ilias they are a curious species capable of unique things and highly adaptable in most cases. Many humans used to worship Ilias, but now most serve as breeding slaves for certain monster girls or live in fear of being milked dry by others.

entries.name: Monster Girls
entries.content: Monster girls, creations of Dark Goddess Alipheese, monster girls come in a variety of shapes in forms, such as slimes, goblins, minotaurs, and etc. They have humanoid appearances and are capable of having children with human men. Some monster girls hunt down humans and drain or consume them for energy and sustenance. All monster are female although monsters have appeared but are extremely rare and are extremely weaker than females.

entries.name: Angels
entries.content: Angels, created by Ilias, the Goddess of Light, Angels are divine servants of the Goddess that follow her orders to the letter. 99% of Angels are female and male angels are extremely weak compared to the females. After the war most surviving angels are sent to Yamatai where they're experimented on inhumanely by Tamamo no Mae and her subordinates.

entries.name: Great Monster Wars
entries.content:
The Great Monster Wars were a massive war between Goddess Ilias and Dark Goddess Alipheese Fateburn aka Alice I (First) that occurred a thousand years ago. 

Several hundred million years ago, Goddess Ilias, the manifestation of light itself, tried to escape her loneliness. She created angels as offshoots of herself, but unsatisfied with her creation, she came to a world and modified its primitive creatures, eventually creating humans. At the same time, Alice I, the manifestation of darkness itself, descended to the same world and created monsters, at a much faster and more controlled rate than Ilias.

Around a thousand years ago, out of jealousy of her power, Ilias and her angels declared war on Alice I and her monsters. The angels Micaela and Lucifina showed their might on the battlefield, and frequently locked in combat with the monstrous Six Ancestors. However, the monster forces were superior, but as the war reached its climax the two deities realized that their constant clashing would destroy the world they had created. While Alice I hesitated, Ilias had continued her onslaught, threatening the existence of the world and their creations. Despite her worries, the Dark Goddess pushed her assault on the forces of Heaven and mostly slaughtered them all, leaving only a few alive. Since then, it has become a world where the strong thrives while the weak perishes, and the Six Ancestors are at the top of it all.

entries.name: Hellgondo
entries.content: Hellgondo, the northern continent known for its strong monster girls since It's the headquarters and home of the Dark Goddess Alipheese. Saja, the ancestor of harpies, dragons, and lamias serves as Alipheese's right hand and lives in the castle with her. The only major city is Remina, a town of coexistance between humans and monster girls.

entries.name: Alice
entries.content:
Alice is the southern continent of Makai with a mostly human population, but under the control of the Dark Goddess and the six Ancestors. It has a few supporters of the late Light Goddess, Goddess Ilias, but any rebellion is quickly put down by the monster girls put in charge of the continent. The continent was once called Ilias at one moment in time but after the war the name was changed to Alice out of spite.

The only notable cities are Aliceville, Aliceport, and Aliceburg, with Aliceburg being the largest city on the Alice continent.
